name: Creation Tongue
body:
Prerequisite(s): 11th level, aasimar

Benefit(s): You can speak Supernal so that listeners understand your words as if spoken in their native language. You can use make whole without a ritual book and can master rituals from the creation category without ever needing a ritual book to perform them.
